exposure: Robotic natural orifice specimen extraction surgery (NOSES)
cohort: Patients who underwent robotic NOSES for colorectal neoplasms performed by two surgeons between March 2016 and October 2019
finding: Robotic NOSES is safe and feasible during the initial learning curve for colorectal neoplasms.
who: Patients undergoing robotic NOSES for colorectal neoplasms
